initial_state: Every attempt starts from a fresh frozen condition copy and a new ephemeral conversation.
token_definition: Cumulative input_tokens + output_tokens. cached_input_tokens is included in input_tokens; reasoning output is included in output_tokens.
time_definition: Monotonic CLI launch-to-process-exit seconds, including model tools/native retries; excludes independent grading and KDoc generation.
quality: Separate thread/context compiles each submission and applies the existing fixed 11 checks using a test Repository. No external product HTTP API.

CLI_distribution.restoration: Official version installed only inside this experiment workspace; existing CLI unchanged. Historical native binary hash unavailable, so historical binary identity is not established.

ledger_numeric_representation.classification: All500 ledger seconds equal the original Python float elapsed_ms / 1000. Preserve ledger and strict mismatch finding; final artifacts use Decimal(str(metadata.elapsed_ms))/1000.

caveats: Historical100 and additional500 were measured at different times.
Server load, cache state and connection notifications may affect latency; recorded durations are retained without adjustment or exclusion.
Descriptive comparisons only; no causal or statistical significance claims.
private_material_excluded: local runtime binaries and helper JARs
aggregation_scope: Successful trials: 100 per condition, 600 in total.
infrastructure_retries: 一時的なインフラエラーは再試行し、成功した試行を集計。
